subject: parser: add support for REFRESH STATS statement and related structures (#61299)
summary: Reviewed parser-only diff vs first parent: adds unreserved keyword/token `REFRESH`, grammar for `REFRESH STATS` with object list forms (`*.*`, `db.*`, `db.tbl`, `tbl`), AST structs `RefreshStatsStmt`/`RefreshObject` with `Restore`, and keyword/tokenMap regeneration plus tests. Looked for SQL-semantic/compat regressions: `REFRESH` is explicitly included in `UnReservedKeyword`, so it remains usable where `Identifier` is accepted; `@var` lexing uses `singleAtIdentifier` and is not impacted by the new keyword mapping. Checked later upstream/master history: subsequent commits only extend syntax (e.g. `FULL`/`LITE`/`CLUSTER`) and add implementation-side helpers (e.g. dedup), without evidence of a bugfix needed for this parser commit.
